Definition: probably for G2491 or G2495; Jonan, an Israelite:--Jonan.
BiblicalUsage: Jonan is one name in Luke's genealogy, standing between Joseph and Eliakim. In Luke 3:30 he is named in the line that runs from Jesus back through David to Adam, one of the links the world forgot.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the forgotten links are the proof of the promise: God kept the line through men whose names we would never know if Luke had not written them down.
